body.input: Which companies expanded to the UK in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available reporting, here are notable companies that expanded to the UK in 2026:

### Technology & Software
- **Rillet** (US) — The agentic ERP platform announced its expansion into the UK in November 2026, opening a new office in central London. European demand already drove 10% of Rillet's net new ARR prior to the move. The expansion came shortly after a $100 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation.
- **OpenAI** (US) — Has been scaling its UK advertising business in 2026, actively hiring for a Head of UK, Ad Solutions role in London to lead and grow its commercial presence with UK advertisers and agencies.
- **Ci Design** (US) — The Baltimore-based architecture and design firm expanded internationally into London in 2026 as part of its growth to eight offices across the US and UK.

### Automotive
- **XPENG** (China, NYSE: XPEV) — Established direct operations in the UK in 2026 and held its first UK Brand Day in November 2026. The company plans five new right-hand-drive models within 12 months and is targeting around 100 retail and service locations across the UK by 2027, including three flagship stores in London and Manchester.

### Nigerian Fintech & Banking
- **LemFi** — Committed £100 million over five years and positioned London as its world headquarters.
- **Moniepoint** — Expanding its London team, aiming to reach 100 employees by end of 2026.
- **Kuda Bank** — Plans to double its UK representation.
- **Zenith Bank** — Opened a new branch in Manchester and is reportedly considering a potential listing on the London Stock Exchange in 2027.

### Other Notable Developments
- The UK government expanded the **Global Talent Visa** route in August 2026 to over 100 private R&D companies (including AstraZeneca, Jaguar Land Rover, GSK, Riverlane, and Notpla), making it easier for international talent to join firms with significant UK operations.
- The **British Business Bank's Investor Pathways Capital Initiative** deployed £100 million to support early-stage venture capital, further encouraging company formation and expansion in the UK.

London, UK, Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rillet, the agentic ERP (enterprise resource planning) platform for modern finance teams, today announced its expansion into the UK, with a new office in central London and its UK team already on the ground. European demand already drives 10% of Rillet’s net new ARR with customers in the UK and across Europe, including some of the fastest-growing AI companies like Black Forest Labs, Temporal, and Primer. [...] Rillet is building a large-scale organization in London, with its founding UK team already in place and significant hiring planned in the months ahead. Rillet has a track record of attracting top talent, and this month, LinkedIn named it on its 2026 Top Startups list of 50 U.S. companies, a signal that UK and European finance teams are in good hands. The goal is to give finance teams in the UK and across Europe a team that is close by, invested in their success, and there for the long term. [...] The expansion comes less than three months after Rillet raised a $100 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation led by ICONIQ, with participation from Sequoia and Andreessen Horowitz. Rillet now serves nearly 1,000 customers across 75 countries, including publicly listed enterprises and some of the fastest-growing companies globally. Rillet’s international net new ARR more than tripled month over month, reflecting accelerating demand beyond US borders.

Team Rillet in the UK.

UK companies were choosing Rillet long before it had a local presence, driving the company’s decision to expand into Europe. Europe is home to some of the world’s most ambitious companies, yet many of their finance teams still close the books on legacy systems.

XPENG UK PRESS EVENT

XPENG UK PRESS EVENT

 

 XPENG sets out its next phase of UK growth at its first UK Brand Day, building on the establishment of direct operations to deepen its long-term commitment to the market.
 Five new right-hand-drive models planned within 12 months, with a nationwide retail and service network targeting around 100 locations within 2027.
 XPENG unveils its Physical AI vision in the UK, extending its ambitions to intelligent technology for everyday life.

LONDON, Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- XPENG (the "Company", NYSE: XPEV, HKEX: 9868) is taking its ambitions in the UK to the next level, setting out a long-term growth strategy that extends beyond expanding its electric vehicle presence to bringing its vision for Physical AI to British consumers. [...] XPENG targets 100 UK retail and service locations and 20 key partnerships within 2027  
XPENG plans to establish a nationwide network of around 100 retail and service locations across the UK within 2027. As part of this expansion, three flagship stores will open in London and Manchester within the next six months, with the aim of bringing an XPENG location within approximately 30 minutes of customers across the UK.

Local partnerships will play a central role in this growth. XPENG is targeting partnerships with 20 leading UK dealer groups and leasing companies in 2027. To deliver a premium ownership experience, XPENG will provide 100% factory-certified specialists, dedicated vehicle handovers and a national parts distribution hub capable of supplying stores in as little as 24 hours. [...] At its first UK Brand Day, introduced by Brian Gu, Vice Chairman and President of XPENG, the company outlined the next phase of its development in the market. Building on the establishment of its direct operations, XPENG is stepping up its investment in the UK through an expanded vehicle portfolio, a stronger nationwide retail and service network, and plans to introduce its next generation of intelligent driving technology.

The strategy reflects XPENG's ambition to build a lasting presence in the UK, while bringing its wider technological capabilities closer to British consumers. Alongside new flagship locations and partnerships with established UK automotive businesses, the company is preparing to introduce a new generation of intelligent mobility experiences to the market.

document.name: XPENG Deepens UK Commitment with New Models, Retail Expansion and Physical AI Ecosystem

As OpenAI’s advertising business continues to scale, the Head of UK will play a critical role in growing the UK business, building strategic advertiser and agency relationships, and developing a high-performing commercial team. You will work closely with EMEA and global leadership to translate OpenAI’s advertising strategy into a clear plan for the UK market.

About the Role

We are seeking a Head of UK, Ad Solutions to lead and scale OpenAI’s advertising business in the United Kingdom. Based in London, you will lead a team of Client Partners and Customer Success Managers supporting UK advertisers and agencies, with responsibility for country strategy, revenue performance and advertiser success. [...] Prioritise UK sectors, advertiser segments and strategic accounts, allocating resources to accelerate adoption, retention and sustainable revenue growth.

   Build and maintain executive-level relationships with leading UK advertisers, agency holding companies, independent agencies and strategic partners.

   Develop agency and technology partnerships that expand advertiser access, improve customer outcomes and support a scalable UK business.

   Partner with sales and customer success teams to strengthen the full advertiser lifecycle, from onboarding and campaign activation to measurement, renewal and expansion.

   Drive forecasting, pipeline management, account and territory planning, and business reviews to improve execution and revenue predictability. [...] This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will identify the sectors, customers and partnerships that offer the greatest opportunity for sustainable growth, build executive-level relationships across the UK advertising industry, and establish the operating discipline needed to deliver ambitious commercial goals.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations and Policy teams to ensure UK advertiser needs inform product development and go-to-market decisions. Working alongside regional and global account teams, you will also help UK-based advertisers and agencies grow their international activity through coordinated account plans.

One of the four endorsement routes is the UKRI Endorsed Funder pathway: an accelerated process for people employed or hosted by a UKRI-approved research organisation on a project funded by an endorsed funder. Until August 2026, only universities and public institutes could use this route.

On 6 August 2026, the UK government announced the opening of the route to more than 100 private companies with significant R&D activity. This is the first time. [...] ### 

Not right now. UKRI stopped accepting new nominations on 30 July 2026. The 100+ companies added this summer were selected through a targeted process, in partnership with professional organisations. Companies that want to be considered can register their interest on the UKRI Engagement Hub. There is no guarantee of inclusion, but it is the only route available at this stage.

Caroline Treuillard

Caroline Treuillard Managing Director France Immigration [...] ✅ AstraZeneca, Jaguar Land Rover and GSK among those approved: The list of approved host organisations spans large pharmaceutical and automotive groups alongside deeptech start-ups such as Riverlane and Notpla.

✅ Eight sectors under the Modern Industrial Strategy: Artificial intelligence, life sciences, clean energy, advanced manufacturing and quantum technologies are among the areas covered.

The list of approved host organisations is maintained by UKRI and updated regularly.

# Venture capital access expanded for early-stage companies in UK

Intention to invest £100 million through British Business Bank’s Investor Pathways Capital Initiative to boost growth in every postcode.

From:
:   HM Treasury, British Business Bank, The Rt Hon Lucy Rigby KC MP and The Rt Hon John Healey MP

Published:
:   7 August 2026 [...] In June, the British Business Bank committed up to £90m to 10 new microfunds as part of the first Investor Pathways Capital cohort. Applications for the next cohort, which is part of this £100m deployment, will open in Autumn 2026.

### Economic Secretary to the Treasury Lucy Rigby said: [...] Recent reforms to the Growth Guarantee Scheme will increase lending capacity by a further £2 billion per year by 2028/29, helping an additional 12,000 smaller businesses access finance each year while extending loan terms and broadening eligibility. These changes are designed to ensure more businesses can secure the funding they need to invest, expand and create jobs.
